programs.description: Contestants from all walks of life compete with each other to win the cash prize while living in the house together under certain rules.
Chandana marries into a family with a troubled past in order to escape her fate. However, can she restore the family's hope?
Vidya's dream of becoming a doctor is threatened when her father decides to get her married. Unfortunately, her father-in-law also believes that women should not pursue education.
Jeevika meets Satvik and marries him with hopes for a bright future together. Her dreams crumble when Satvik demands a divorce on their wedding night.
Gowri and her sisters experience a life-altering shift upon encountering the Deenabandhu brothers, as fate draws the two families together into an uncertain future.
Nandakumar shares a close relationship with his family. However, when enemies threaten his loved ones, can he stop his family from breaking apart?
Fate leads Pavithra to an unexpected encounter at Amma's Coffee shop, oblivious to the peril around her. Her life takes a dramatic turn when an unforeseen marriage to Dev abruptly alters her destiny.
